heading_en: Outline of Calculation of the Market Risk Equivalent Amount for Default Risk
summary_ja: デフォルト・リスクに対するマーケット・リスク相当額の算出手順(JTDリスク・ポジションの算出、相殺、バケット分類、合算)と、算出上の要件を定める。
summary_en: Sets the steps for calculating the market risk equivalent amount for default risk (gross and net JTD risk positions, bucketing, risk weighting and aggregation) and the requirements that apply to the calculation.

sections_en.第三節 第三款: Market Risk Equivalent Amount for Default Risk under the Standardized Approach

paragraphs: The market risk equivalent amount for default risk shall capture JTD risk that cannot be captured by the sensitivities-based method, and shall be calculated as provided below. (i) It shall be calculated by classifying products into the following categories. (a) Non-securitization products (excluding products classified under (c)). (b) Securitization products (non-CTP). (c) Securitization products (CTP). (ii) The gross JTD risk position (meaning the portion of the present value of a product that may give rise to a loss upon default of the obligor, etc.; the same applies below) shall be calculated for each exposure. (iii) Of the gross JTD risk positions, the amount of long positions and the amount of short positions to the same obligor, etc. shall be offset to calculate the net JTD risk position. (iv) In classifying long positions and short positions in the preceding item, a position that gives rise to a loss upon default shall be a long position. (v) The net JTD risk positions shall be classified into buckets. (vi) The net JTD risk position shall be multiplied by the risk weight, and those belonging to the same bucket shall be aggregated. In this case, in order to take into account the hedge benefit between long positions and short positions, the amount obtained by multiplying the short positions by the hedge benefit ratio shall be deducted from the long positions. (vii) The simple sum of the market risk equivalent amounts of the buckets calculated in the preceding item shall be the market risk equivalent amount for default risk.

In calculating the market risk equivalent amount for default risk, all of the following requirements shall be satisfied. (i) Diversification effects shall not be recognized among the portfolios listed in item (i)(a) through (c) of the preceding paragraph. (ii) For basket-type listed credit derivatives and equity derivatives that are non-securitization products, the look-through approach shall be used to calculate the JTD risk position of each issuer of the constituents. (iii) Hedges by non-securitization products in securitization products (CTP) shall be subject to the calculation of the market risk equivalent amount for default risk. In this case, such hedges by non-securitization products shall not be included in the market risk equivalent amount for default risk for non-securitization products. (iv) For exposures for which the risk weight is 0% in the calculation of credit risk-weighted assets under Article 22 through Article 24 and Article 26, paragraph (3), the risk weight may be 0%. (v) An investment in a fund for which the market risk equivalent amount is calculated by the method set out in Article 262-2, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be treated as an unrated equity-related product. (vi) Where the investment mandate of a fund permits investment in names with speculative-grade ratings or in financial distress, the effective average risk weight shall be calculated using a hypothetical position relating to the maximum risk envisaged under that investment mandate. In this case, offsetting and the taking into account of diversification between the exposures arising from the hypothetical position used to calculate that effective average risk weight and other exposures shall not be done.
